subject: Tree Preservation and Protection Ordinance
overview: The committee met to address the status of the proposed Tree Preservation and Protection Ordinance and stalled progress on the legal drafting process. The Council voted to refer the matter to a subcommittee and seek formal feedback from city departments while pressuring outside legal counsel for an updated draft.

items.title: Tree Preservation and Protection Ordinance Status
items.summary: The committee reviewed the draft ordinance and discussed a refusal by outside legal counsel to provide an updated version until the Council resolves outstanding policy decisions.

items.title: Public and Departmental Testimony
items.summary: The DPW Commissioner raised concerns regarding staffing requirements and conflicts with state law, while residents debated the balance between canopy protection and individual property rights.

items.title: Motion for Interdepartmental Review
items.summary: Approved a motion requesting the departments of Planning, Public Works, and Finance to meet and provide joint comments on the draft ordinance and a proposed tree removal moratorium.

items.title: Subcommittee Referral
items.summary: Referred the paper to the Climate Subcommittee for further deliberation.

items.title: Motion to Resubmit Legal Drafting Request
items.summary: Approved a motion to resubmit a previous request for a segmented draft to the Mayor and Chief of Staff, seeking a 10-day response from legal counsel.
